integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the statement and reduction of the Hypercube inequality and at its higher-dimensional limitations. The specialized coefficient polynomial is reconstructed by an exhaustive exact determinant census of all 4368 five-vertex subsets of the 4-cube. The all-parameter sharp constant is then proved by an explicit exact polynomial certificate with positive-coefficient cubic multipliers; no numerical optimization or sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves a sharp strengthened form of the d=4 Hypercube inequality only on the three-parameter cone of weights invariant under coordinate permutations and vertex complementation. It does not settle the unrestricted sixteen-variable d=4 conjecture, the five-parameter Hamming-radial cone, or general complement-symmetric weights.
title: Sharp symmetric gap for the first open hypercube inequality
